movement_model.walk_edges: Curated public paths between interaction areas. Each directed edge stores an elapsed range for ordinary movement. Straight-line tile distance does not create an edge.
movement_model.run_energy: Estimates allow ordinary running where available. The draft carries no exact run-energy meter and makes no stamina or equipment-speed assumption.
movement_model.transfers: Ferry edges include walking between the island dock and Auguste. Balloon first-flight actions include their navigation and arrival. Quest travel bundled into a stage is counted there.
movement_model.training: Training resumes at the listed waypoint. The user chooses the method, supplies and travel for that training.

profile_gates.flag.travel.balloon_light_pack: Assert only for a loadout that stays below 40 kg when using a balloon, including its fuel and equipment.
profile_gates.flag.travel.varrock_square_selected: Assert when the account uses the market-square Varrock destination.

entrana_equipment: Ferry and balloon arrivals check the catalog's prohibited items against the current inventory. The Port Sarim deposit box can bank the restricted gear.
pending_measurement: Record representative times with run energy available and with walking only.
Check exact interaction and landing tiles for configurable teleports.
Track equipment and inventory weight directly, including any supplies acquired on the route.
